title: War on the Grey Barrow Moors
changes: The Grey Barrow Moors join the clan war: eleven moor territories, all held by the Ossuary Host, whose seat is now the Host's Muster.
The Barrowgate joins the moors to the Oakvale Lands on the war table. Greywatch Keep and Kharsun are no longer Host capitals and can be taken.
The Cairnwatch bounty board now offers war writs for the moors. Cairnwatch, the Barrow-King's Mound and the open moor stay out of the war.
